notes.title: Game Update v5.0.0
notes.content: We've just updated the game to the latest version of the HexWar Engine. This includes various bug fixes and performance improvements!

notes.title: Ancient Battle: Alexander - version 3.0.4 update
notes.content:
Fix: Update the display of the campaign names in the completed campaigns window.
 Fix: Some sound effects not playing following the last update.

notes.title: Ancient Battle: Alexander Version 3.0.3 Update
notes.content: Fix: Some sound effects not playing following the last update.

notes.title: Ancient Battle: Alexander Update version 3.0.2
notes.content: Fix: National flags not displaying some-times.

notes.title: Ancient Battle: Alexander Version 3.0,1 Patch
notes.content:
Change: Campaign map graphics. It is now clearer which campaigns have been selected and completed.
 Change: Improved A.I. opponent.
 Change: Improved game logic for advance after combat. Unit will more often advance after combat if the target hex has been vacated.
 Fix: An issue with the image scaling of SD images.
 Fix: Some screen layout issues.
 Fix: Some projectile animations not displaying.
 Fix: Invalid font selection on some buttons on some platforms.
 Remove: References to Persian cavalry with spears.
 Update: Source material credits.
 Update: 'About Game' window.

notes.title: Update.
notes.content: Fix: A major update to the game AI.  Ranged units that were far from enemy units are now more responsive.
